verdict.line: You lose if Garen lands Decisive Strike's silence into a level 6+ all-in; you win if you pull him with E before he closes and bank the trade into W.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp, range 700) and Q (Obliterate, range 675) both outrange every tool Garen has (Q range 300, E range 325), so Mordekaiser dictates when fights start. The counter is Garen's Q (Decisive Strike): its silence shuts off your ability to consume Indestructible's shield or activate R mid-trade, and once he hits level 6 his 20s-cooldown-at-rank-3 Demacian Justice threatens an execute on anyone he's already damaged. That tension is why the measured 47% win rate over 151 games sits just below even despite Mordekaiser holding the lane and solo-kill edge on paper.

theirWindow.when: his Q is up and he's level 6+
theirWindow.what: He can silence your next ability on contact and follow with a Judgment (E) spin plus auto-attacks, then threaten Demacian Justice if you're already low. Back off and let a wave push instead of contesting.

yourWindow.what: Open with E to pull him into your max range, land Q for its single-target bonus damage, and auto to build Darkness Rise stacks. Only consume your W shield for healing after he's dumped his Judgment spin into you.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 55.3% win-rate page's keystone — stacks through the extended trades E's pull forces, and the healing on full stacks offsets Garen's regen passive.

summoners.why: Run in 79.8% of games at a 50.7% win rate — Ignite converts your E-into-Q all-in into a kill before Garen's Perseverance regen ticks him back up.

playing.title: Pull with E before he closes
playing.detail: Death's Grasp's 700 range beats his 300-range Q, so landing it first guarantees your Q connects before he's in his own attack range.

playing.title: Track his Q before all-inning
playing.detail: If Decisive Strike is up, expect a silence on his next attack that shuts off your W heal or R cast mid-fight — wait it out or bait it on a minion first.

playing.title: Save R for a confirmed kill
playing.detail: Realm of Death's cooldown runs 140s down to 80s at max rank, so don't burn it to poke — use it only when you're certain you can finish him, since you keep his stolen stats if he dies inside it.

playing.title: Time your W consumption late
playing.detail: Let Indestructible bank the damage from his Judgment spin and autos, then consume the shield right after he commits so you heal off his full trade.

playing.title: Don't crash waves past level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice executes based on missing health, so avoid parking under his tower low on HP once he has it — Mordekaiser's own R needs him to be closer than Garen's ult range anyway.

playing.title: Wait for armor before hard trades
playing.detail: Matches the matchup read directly: get Plated Steelcaps and your first armor component before initiating extended fights, since early trades favor his flat physical damage.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured Mordekaiser-vs-Garen games on the current patch; the trade timing, ability interactions, and power-curve calls are my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Garen when he reachese level 6. Use your skills to farm and contest lane. Wait for a chance after purchasing items with armor.
